description: This source file implements the HmacSerializable class, which provides mechanisms for serializing and deserializing data with HMAC-based integrity verification, specifically for secure environment operations in a project related to Android's open-source platform. The file includes methods for size calculation, serialization, deserialization, and appending additional data (AAD). It references internal TPM (Trusted Platform Module) HMAC functions and serialization utilities.

classes.name: HmacSerializable
classes.description: A class that handles serialization of data with appended HMAC for integrity, used within secure environment operations, supporting inner serialization and deserialization with authentication checks.

methods.name: HmacSerializable(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,std::function<TpmObjectSlot (TpmResourceManager &)> signing_key_fn,uint32_t digest_size,Serializable * wrapped,const Serializable * aad)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HmacSerializable object with necessary parameters including resource management, key retrieval function, digest size, and wrapped serializable object.

methods.name: size_t SerializedSize() const
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total size of the serialized data, including the digest and wrapped data size.

methods.name: uint8_t * Serialize(uint8_t * buf,const uint8_t * end) const
methods.description: Serializes the wrapped object, appends an HMAC over its data and optional AAD, and writes the result into the provided buffer.

methods.name: bool Deserialize(const uint8_t ** buf_ptr,const uint8_t * end)
methods.description: Reads serialized data, verifies HMAC, and reconstructs the inner wrapped object if integrity checks pass.

methods.name: std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> AppendAad(const uint8_t * sensitive,size_t sensitive_size) const
methods.description: Appends additional associated data (AAD) to the sensitive data, if AAD exists, for integrity protection.
